{{Quote|Now ''our'' method should offer a more ''permanent'' solution&hellip;''"<br />"''My ''word''. I ''am'' impressed, Sergeant!|Gaffa and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Repel All Boarders" />}}
'''Gaffa''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who was selected to become a [[clone engineer]] and served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[38th Armored Division]]. Gaffa fought alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the rest of his division during a [[Skirmish aboard the Twilight|space battle]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. The Republic lost the battle and the Jedi and clone troopers were forced to flee with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] in pursuit. After the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] damaged the [[Twilight/Legends|ship]] the Republic survivors were traveling in, a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] boarded the ship. However, due to the Jedi's skill in combat, the 38th Armored Division was able to quickly convert their broken down [[A5-RX battle tank]] into a [[A5-RX Spread-Missile Battle Platform|battle platform]] which they used to repel the boarders and destroy their pursuers.<ref name="Repel All Boarders" />
